ValidationRule.description: Prevents manually selecting the Submitted status on Water Lab Test Requisitions; Submitted is reserved for the integration process. Exception: assigning a Facility to an orphan requisition (PHOCSManageOrphanLabRequisitions).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), ISBLANK(SubmittedDateTime__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterLabTestRequisition", $Profile.Name <> "Salesforce API Only System Integrations", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT(AND( $Permission.PHOCSManageOrphanLabRequisitions, NOT(ISNEW()), ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(FacilityName__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(FacilityName__c)) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a different value in the Status field. 'Submitted' is reserved for integration process only.
